question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

There was **__palpable__ **tension in the negotiation room.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined word in this sentence is **'palpable' **which means able to be touched or felt.
 
• The English meaning of **'Palpable' **is noticeable or obvious (हिंदी में - स्पष्ट).
 
 
• **Example:** His excitement was palpable when he received the award.
 
 
 
• The synonym to **'Palpable' **in this context is **'Detectable', **which is something that can be discovered or noticed.
 
• The Hindi meaning of **'Detectable' is 'पता लगाने योग्य'. **
 
 
• **​Example: **The virus is not detectable in the early stages of the disease.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- **'Option 4'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 

 
• **"Indistinguishable" **is not a good match as it means that something is so similar to another thing that it's impossible to differentiate.
 
• **"Imperceptible" **also doesn't align with **"palpable" **as it means something that's so slight, slow, or gradual that it's not easily perceived or noticed.
 
• **"Insensible" **is not suitable here because it means lacking physical sensation or consciousness, or unaware or indifferent.
